reasoning: A(1,2)->B(7,10): dx=6, dy=8, diameter=10, radius=5. Kept the original '10' (computed the diameter and stopped there) as the single remaining relation - it is the error nearly every student makes on this item. Dropped 25 (square) and 50 (times ten). New: 7 = half of the taxicab distance |6|+|8|=14 (added the legs instead of using Pythagoras, then halved). New: 3 = half of the horizontal run 6 alone (used only the x-difference as the diameter). Remaining relation count: 1 (10 = 2*5).

(2,3)->(8,11): dx=6, dy=8, diameter=10, radius=5. Kept '10' (diameter reported as the radius). Dropped 50 (times ten) and 25 (square). New: 7 = (6+8)/2, added the legs instead of squaring, then halved. New: 3 = 6/2, used only the horizontal difference as the diameter. Remaining relation count: 1 (10 = 2*5).

Central angle 100 -> inscribed angle 50. Kept '100°' (read the central angle as the answer, the classic no-halving error) as the single relation. Dropped 130 (=180-50) and 25 (=50/2); note 130 and 25 also relate to the replacement values, so both had to go. New: 65° - if P is on the major arc, arcs AP and PB total 360-100=260, so each is 130 and the inscribed angle at A (angle PAB) is 65; a student who finds the wrong vertex of triangle APB gets this. New: 260° - the measure of the major arc P lies on, given by a student who confuses the intercepted arc with the angle (the stem names the major arc, which is what invites it). Remaining relation count: 1 (100 = 2*50).

dx=15, dy=20, distance=25. Kept '625' (computed 15^2+20^2=625 and forgot the square root) as the single relation - the most common slip on distance problems. Dropped '5' (sqrt of the key). '17.5' was already not slip-derived (it is (15+20)/2) and is retained. New: 13.23 = sqrt(20^2-15^2)=sqrt(175), subtracting the squares instead of adding them. Remaining relation count: 1 (625 = 25^2).

Central angle 80 -> inscribed angle 40. Kept '80°' (central angle used directly) as the single relation. Dropped '50°' (=90-40; it is also the base angle of isosceles triangle AOB, but it is the exact complement slip the rule targets). Retained '30°', which was not slip-derived. New: 70° - arcs AP and PB together measure 360-80=280, so each is 140 and the inscribed angle at A (angle PAB) is 70; a student who computes the angle at the wrong vertex of triangle APB lands here. Remaining relation count: 1 (80 = 2*40).

Legs 15 and 36 -> hypotenuse sqrt(225+1296)=sqrt(1521)=39. Kept '51' - it is flagged as 90-39, but its real source is 15+36=51, adding the legs instead of using Pythagoras, which is the error a real student makes here. Dropped '40' (plus one) and '37'. New: 32.73 = sqrt(36^2-15^2)=sqrt(1071), subtracting the squares instead of adding. New: 45 = assuming a 3-4-5 family from the 36 (36/4=9, so 9*5=45, i.e. reading the triangle as 27-36-45). Remaining relation count: 1 (51 = 90-39).

x^2+y^2-6x+8y-11=0 -> (x-3)^2+(y+4)^2 = 11+9+16 = 36, r=6. Kept '36' (stopped at r^2, forgot the square root) as the single relation. Retained '√11' (read the constant term as r^2), which was not slip-derived. Dropped '5' (minus one). New: √14 - sign error while completing the square, r^2 = 9+16-11 = 14 (subtracting the constant instead of moving it across). Remaining relation count: 1 (36 = 6^2).

Hypotenuse 41, leg 9 -> AB = sqrt(1681-81) = sqrt(1600) = 40. Kept '50' - flagged as 90-40, but its real source is 41+9=50, adding the two given lengths. Retained '32' (=41-9, subtracting lengths instead of squares), which is not slip-derived. Dropped '41' (plus one / copying the hypotenuse). New: 41.98 = sqrt(41^2+9^2)=sqrt(1762), adding the squares instead of subtracting - i.e. treating AC as a leg. Remaining relation count: 1 (50 = 90-40).

Tangent: PT = sqrt(41^2-9^2) = sqrt(1600) = 40. Kept '50' - flagged as 90-40, but really 41+9, adding the radius to the centre distance. Retained '√1762' (=sqrt(41^2+9^2), adding the squares), not slip-derived. Dropped '41' (plus one / copying the given distance). New: 32 = 41-9, subtracting the lengths rather than the squares. Remaining relation count: 1 (50 = 90-40).

x^2+y^2-6x+8y+9=0 -> (x-3)^2+(y+4)^2 = -9+9+16 = 16, r=4. Kept '16' (stopped at r^2) as the single relation. Retained '5.83' (=sqrt(34), sign error giving r^2 = 9+16+9), not slip-derived. Dropped '5' (plus one). New: 9.54 = sqrt(91) - forgot to halve the linear coefficients, giving (x-6)^2+(y+8)^2 and r^2 = 36+64-9 = 91. Remaining relation count: 1 (16 = 4^2).

Legs 10 and 24 -> hypotenuse 26; the median from the right angle is half the hypotenuse = 13. Kept '26' (gave the hypotenuse itself, the error the item is built to catch). Retained '9.23' (=10*24/26, the altitude to the hypotenuse rather than the median), not slip-derived. Dropped '6.5' (halve). New: 17 = (10+24)/2, averaging the legs instead of halving the hypotenuse. Remaining relation count: 1 (26 = 2*13).

Same circle: r^2 = -9+9+16 = 16, r=4. Kept '16' (stopped at r^2). Retained '√34' (sign error, r^2 = 9+16+9), not slip-derived. Dropped '5' (plus one). New: √91 - did not halve the linear coefficients, so r^2 = 36+64-9 = 91. Remaining relation count: 1 (16 = 4^2).

Tangent: PT = sqrt(15^2-9^2) = sqrt(144) = 12. Kept '6' - flagged as halve, but its real source is 15-9=6, subtracting the lengths instead of the squares, which is the error students actually make. Retained '√306' (=sqrt(15^2+9^2), added the squares), not slip-derived. Dropped '24' (double / 15+9). New: 7.2 = 9*12/15, the altitude from T to OP - the value a student gets after drawing the perpendicular from the point of tangency and stopping one step early. Remaining relation count: 1 (6 = 12/2).

Same circle: r^2 = -9+9+16 = 16, r=4. Kept '16' (stopped at r^2). Retained '√34' (sign error, r^2 = 9+16+9), not slip-derived. Dropped '5' (plus one). New: √43 - halved only the y-coefficient, giving (x-6)^2+(y+4)^2 and r^2 = 36+16-9 = 43. Remaining relation count: 1 (16 = 4^2).
